name: Demolitionist Gift
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 4/legendary alchemist 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components v, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours

DESCRIPTION

This extract is mixed with the rare poison of the crimson scorpion prepared in an incredibly exacting fashion, transforming an alchemist’s bombs into a soothing concoction.

As long as you are under the effects of demolitionist gift, once per round when you damage a creature with your bombs, you heal an amount of hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier. For the spell’s duration, you gain a +2 alchemical bonus on all saving throws.
